registered_before: the first run of scripts/optimization/blend_matched_thrust_v5.py; P6.1 held-out results were known (they do not enter this design)
engine: Trent 1000-AE3 inputs (ICAO record 02P23RR126: OPR, BPR, rated thrust); v5 calibration outputs/calibration_v5_A2.json; A1 central fixed values; single-zone equilibrium combustor; analytic turbine and nozzle
operating_points: ICAO LTO thrust x * F_rated for TAKE-OFF (primary), APPROACH, IDLE; phi solved by run_at_thrust (not a design variable)
blend_basis: mass fractions (p_JetA, p_HEFA, p_FT, p_ATJ) of the four component surrogates, converted to mixture mole fractions for Cantera; SAF total <= 0.5 by mass (ASTM D7566 limits are volumetric; surrogate densities are not modelled, so the mass cap is an approximation)

design.sampler: scipy.stats.qmc.Sobol(d=4, scramble=True, seed) over (SAF total/0.5, w_HEFA, w_FT, w_ATJ); p_i = SAF * w_i / sum(w)
design.corsia_per_point: seeded triangular draw per design point, formula of optimize_blend.draw_lcef (seed * 1000003 + index); used by the variance decomposition
design.corsia_central: triangular mode per pathway; fossil baseline 89 gCO2e/MJ

outputs_per_point: NOx (ICAO-derived correlation of OPR and fuel flow; no composition term)
lifecycle CO2e g/s = fuel flow * sum_i p_i LHV_i L_CEF_i
p62_conditioning: the four reference blends are re-run under each of the 64 P6.2 draws (fixed values and refitted parameters from outputs/p62_bands_v5.csv)

ranking_rule.pairs: each SAF-50 reference vs Jet-A1, and the three SAF-50 references against each other, per mode, for fuel flow, TSFC, T4, NOx, lifecycle CO2e
ranking_rule.spread_a: Monte-Carlo spread: P5-P95 width of the paired difference over the 1000 common CORSIA draws (lifecycle); 0 for cycle quantities (deterministic; phi solved to xtol 1e-12)
ranking_rule.band_b: P6.2 band: P5-P95 width of the quantity for Jet-A1 across the 64 P6.2 draws
ranking_rule.claim: a ranking is claimed iff |central difference| > spread_a AND > band_b (plan P6.3 item 3)
ranking_rule.reported_not_gating: paired P6.2 difference: P5-P95 and the fraction of draws whose sign matches the central difference

variance_decomposition: scripts/analysis/variance_decomposition.py --v5, over the 256 Sobol points at TAKE-OFF: (1) random-forest permutation-importance shares (existing variance_shares, seed 42) of fuel flow, TSFC, T4, NOx and lifecycle CO2e (per-point draw) over features p_HEFA, p_FT, p_ATJ, lcef_draw_HEFA, lcef_draw_FT, lcef_draw_ATJ, with R^2; (2) Spearman correlation of those outputs; (3) CORSIA rank stability: the Pareto set on (TSFC, lifecycle CO2e, NOx) at the central CORSIA values, then the fraction of the 1000 common draws in which each central Pareto member stays Pareto-optimal (lifecycle recomputed per draw for all points). Decision rule carried from Phase 2: membership stable in < 50 % of draws => blend-selection statements are scenario-conditional
supersedes: optimize_blend.py free-phi and fixed-phi studies (blends at unequal thrust); kept only as the v4 reproduction path
